description: Fetch one code by id: its current destination, label, group, external_ref, the permanent short_url and the artifact URLs. Use it to confirm where a code points right now before changing it, or to re-read a code returned earlier.

codeId.description: The code id (UUID), as returned by qrtap_create_code, qrtap_create_codes_bulk or qrtap_list_codes. This is the internal id, not the short_url slug.

name: qrtap_get_code
